title: Clean-room eval run record
description: What ONE agent run against ONE task in ONE prepared clean-room sandbox produced. The harness does not write this file: whoever launches the agent does, from the launcher's own transcript metadata. evals/score.py consumes it together with the machine-check results that cleanroom.py check emitted.

run_id.description: Unique within a comparison set, e.g. A1-opus-2026-08-08-01.

task_id.description: Must match the task definition's id.

label.description: Short routing label used as the comparison column header (opus / sonnet / haiku / operator).

harness.description: Claude Code, SDK, API loop, human.

launcher.description: HOW the agent was started. The harness never launches an agent; this field is the record of what did.

skill_loaded.description: false marks a no-skill baseline run (skill-efficiency-gen5.md section 5: baseline first).

install_report.description: Path to the install_report.json of the sandbox this run used.

completed.description: Did the agent finish the task on its own?

operator_intervened.description: true invalidates the run as a clean-room result; keep it and say so.

transcript.description: Efficiency metrics from the launcher. Every field is optional except steps: a launcher that cannot report tokens leaves them null rather than guessing.

retries.description: Times the agent re-ran a failed command or redid a step.

skill_loaded.description: Tokens the loaded SKILL.md itself occupies (the W5.3 acceptance's loaded-token footprint).

judgment.description: Human or LLM-judge verdicts against the task's expected_behavior[] rubric, in the same order.

failure_mode.description: One short phrase naming HOW it failed, for the routing table's last column: e.g. 'edited original in place', 'invented unsupplied values', 'reimplemented preedit inline', 'gave up after residue exit 3'.
